product_metadata.title: My Foldaway Rechargeable Fan, All in 1 Folding Fan for Bedroom/Desk and More, Portable Travel Fan Fits in Suitcase, 10 Hour Battery Life, Quiet Foldable Fan from 4”- 40” with 3 Modes AS SEEN ON TV
features: My Foldaway Fan: The My Foldaway Fan Folding Fan is the only fan you’ll need for your home, office, or vacation- This fan’s foldable design is ideal for home, office, and travel use while the rechargeable design makes it’s a perfect fit for use on the go or outdoors. Simply fold the fan and place on your desktop or bedside for a cool breeze or extend the fan to stand and cool down an entire room.

Extendable Fan: The My Foldaway Fan features a telescopic neck and is extendable from 4” up to 40” providing multiple use options, making it ideal for desktops, bedsides, sofas, kitchens, living rooms, outdoors, cars, and more.

Portable and Compact: My Foldaway Fan has a super lightweight finish weighing only 2 pounds and has a collapsible design, folding the fan within itself, and allowing for easy packing in suitcases and carryon bags.
Wireless and Rechargeable: Use this fan outdoors or on the go with the wireless and rechargeable design. Simply charge the fan with the USB cable included and enjoy up to 10 hours of cool air.
Long Battery Life: My Foldaway Fan features a rechargeable lithium battery, giving you up to 10 straight hours of use on a full charge, ensuring you will always have a fan ready to use when needed.

Whisper Quiet: My Foldaway Fan is designed with an ultra-quiet motor, creating minimal noise and sound while in use, and allowing you to work, sleep, or relax with cool air, without any of the loud background noise or headaches.
3 Modes: The 3 interchangeable modes- Low, medium, and high- allow you to choose the amount of air to your preference. Simply hold the button for 3 seconds to change between modes.
Versatile Fan: The My Foldaway Fan is the ideal fan for use on the go, in your home, at work, or even outdoors. Simply charge the fan, unfold it, and use anywhere you desire.
description: Introducing the ultimate 2-in-1 Folding Fan, a versatile and compact solution designed to provide you with a refreshing breeze wherever you go. This innovative fan combines the convenience of a table fan and the functionality of a desk fan, making it the perfect companion for your daily cooling needs. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the move, this fan is sure to keep you comfortable. With its rechargeable feature, you can bid farewell to tangled cords and limited mobility. The Folding Fan comes with a built-in rechargeable battery, allowing you to enjoy uninterrupted airflow for hours on end. Simply charge it up using the included USB cable, and you're all set to experience the cooling sensation whenever and wherever you desire. Don't be fooled by its compact size; this fan packs a punch when it comes to power. Engineered with cutting-edge technology, it delivers a strong and steady breeze to help you beat the heat. Thanks to its ultra-quiet operation, you can enjoy a peaceful environment without any distracting noise, making it the ideal Fan for Bedroom use. The Folding Fan's versatility extends beyond its cooling capabilities. Its unique folding design allows you to effortlessly transform it from a table fan to a desk fan in a matter of seconds. Adjust the angle to your liking and let the cool air circulate throughout the room, enhancing your comfort and improving air circulation. With its sleek and modern design, this Folding Fan is not only practical but also aesthetically pleasing. It seamlessly blends into any space, complementing your décor with its minimalist elegance. Take control of your comfort with the 2-in-1 Folding Fan, the ultimate solution for a refreshing breeze anytime, anywhere. Get yours today and experience the unparalleled cooling power for yourself. Fan for Bedroom, the perfect cooling companion.
